question_text: Eight executives J, K, L, M, N, O, P & Q are sitting around a circular table for a meeting. J is second to the right of P who is third to the right of K. M is second to the left of O who sits between P & J, L is not a neighbour of K or N. J, K, L, M, N, O, P Q J, P K M, O P J L, K N (i) Who is opposite to Q? Q (a) O (b) J (c) P (d) K (ii) Who is second to the left of J ? J (a) L (b) P (c) M (d) K (iii) Who is sitting between K and M? K M (a) O (b) L (c) P (d) N (iv) Who is second to the right of K? K (a) M (b) L (c) J (d) O (v) Who are immediate neighbours of N? N (a) M & P (b) K & M (c) K & Q (d) O & P

A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circle, facing the centre. A sits fourth to the right of H while second to the left of F. C is not the neighbour of F and B. D sits third to the right of C. H never sits next to G. A, B, C, D, E, F, G H A, H F C, F B D, C H G (i) Who is sitting between B & D? B D (a) A (b) G (c) H (d) F (ii) Who is third to the right of F? F (a) H (b) E (c) G (d) B (iii) Who are immediate neighbours of D? D (a) A & F (b) C & E (c) E & F (d) G & H (iv) Who is opposite to G? G (a) H (b) B (c) D (d) F (v) In which of the following pairs is the first person sitting to the immediate right of the second person? (a) BH (b) AF (c) EH (d) EC

M, N, P, R, T, W, F and H are sitting around a circle facing the centre, P is third to the left of M and second to the right of T. N is second to the right of P. R is second to the right of W who is second to the right of M. F is not an immediate neighbour of P. M, N, P, R, T, W, F H P, M T N, P R, W M F, P (i) Who are immediate neighbours of H? H (a) P & N (b) N & M (c) P & R (d) W & F (ii) What is the position of R with respect to N? N R (a) Second to the left/ (b) Third to the left/ (c) Second to the right/ (d) Third to the right/ (iii) How many people sit between N & T? N T (a) Only 2 (b) Only 4 (c) Only 2 or 4 (d) Only 3 (iv) Who is on the immediate right of W? W (a) F (b) T (c) N (d) M (v) In which of the following pairs is the first person sitting to the immediate left of the second person? (a) NH (b) FM (c) TW (d) RP

A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circle, facing the centre. E and G always sit next to each other. D sits third to the right of C. F sits second to the left of H. C never sits next to A while D never sits next to G. H is not the neighbour of D and C. A, B, C, D, E, F, G H E G D, C F, H C A D G H, D C (i) Who is sitting on the immediate right of D? D (a) F (b) E (c) H (d) C (ii) What is the position of D with respect to G? G D (a) Second to the left/ (b) Sixth to the left/ (c) Second to the right/ (d) Sixth to the left and second to the right (iii) Who is fourth to the left of A? Q (a) H (b) G (c) B (d) C (iv) If C and H interchange their places, who will be second to the left of E? C H E (a) B (b) C (c) H (d) A (v) Who are immediate neighbours of G? G (a) C & E (b) F & H (c) A & B (d) D & E

J, P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are married couple sitting around a circle, facing the centre. The profession of the males within the group are lecturer, lawyer, doctor and scientist. Among the males, only R (the lawyer) and V (the scientist) are sitting together. Each man is seated be sides his wife. U, the wife of the lecturer is seated second to the right of V. T is seated between U and V. P is the wife of the doctor. Q is not the doctor. S is a male. J, P, Q, R, S, T, U V R V U, V T U V P Q S (i) Who among the following is a doctor? (a) Q (b) S (c) T (d) J (ii) Who among the following is a lecturer? (a) Q (b) S (c) T (d) J (iii) Who among the following is the wife of the lawyer? (a) T (b) J (c) Q (d) S (iv) Who is on the immediate left of the scientist? (a) Husband of T/T (b) Husband of J/J (c) Husband of P/P (d) Husband of U/U (v) T is sitting between which of the following? T (a) J & P (b) S & J (c) Q & R (d) U & V

A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Each one of them has a different profession viz. doctor, engineer, architect, teacher, clerk, shopkeeper, business- man and banker. A sits third to right of teacher. D sits second to left of G. G is not an immediate neigh- bour of the teacher. Only one person sits between B who is the shopkeeper and teacher. The one who is an architect sits third to the right of the shop- keeper. H sits between architect and engineer. E is not an immediate neighbour of H. Engineer sits third to the right of clerk. Only one person sits between businessman and F. E is neither a businessman nor a doctor. A, B, C, D, E, F, G H A, D, G G, B H E, H F E (i) Who among the following is a banker? (a) G (b) D (c) H (d) E (ii) Who among the following is an architect? (a) H (b) F (c) E (d) G (iii) Who among the following is an engineer? (a) E (b) F (c) C (d) G (iv) How many people sit between engineer and clerk? (a) Only 2 (b) Only 3 (c) Only 4 (d) Only 2 or 4 (v) Who is on the immediate right of the doctor? (a) Businessman/ (b) Banker/ (c) Architect/ (d) Teacher/

Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a circle. Five of them are facing the centre while two of them are facing opposite to the centre. C sits third to the left of D and both are facing the centre E is neither an immediate neighbour of D nor of C. The one sitting exactly between D and F is facing opposite to the centre. G sits third to the right of A and G is facing the centre. One of B' neighbour is facing oppo- site to the centre. A, B, C, D, E, F G C, D E D C D F G, A B (i) Who sits third to the left of G? G (a) A (b) B (c) D (d) C (ii) Who are immediate neighbour of E? E (a) A & D (b) G & B (c) G & C (d) B & D (iii) Who among the following is facing opposite to the centre? (a) F (b) E (c) D (d) G (iv) Who among the following is facing the centre? (a) B (b) A (c) E (d) None of these (v) Who is sitting on the immediate right of A? A (a) F (b) D (c) B (d) G

A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre in such a way that four of them sit at four corners of the square while four sit in the middle of each of the four sides. A, B, C, D, E, F, G H A. A sits second to the right of F, F sits in the middle of one of the sides of the table. A, F F B. G who does not sit at any of the corners of the table sits second to the right of D. G, D C. Only two people sit between D and B (taken from one side) B D D. C is not an immediate neighbour of G. C, G E. H sits second to left of B. H, B F. E is not an immediate neighbour of G or F. E, G F (i) Who among the following sits in the middle of the side? (a) H (b) D (c) E (d) C (ii) Who among the following sits at the corner? (a) D (b) G (c) E (d) F (iii) Who sits between E and H? E H (a) F (b) D (c) A (d) G (iv) Who is opposite to D? D (a) F (b) B (c) A (d) G (v) If A and G interchange their places, who will be third to the right of F? A G F (a) G (b) A (c) E (d) D

Eight people- S, R, N, L, M, T, O and P are sitting in a circle facing the centre. All eight belong to different professions – reporter, doctor, cricketer, teacher, accountant, shopkeeper, painter and supervisor. They are not necessarily seated in the mentioned order. M is sitting third to the left of O. The docter is to the immediate right of M and M is not a reporter. R is sitting fourth to the right of P. Neither R nor P is an immediate neighbour of M. T is a teacher and is sitting third to the right of the doctor. The shop- keeper is sitting second to the left of the teacher. The painter is sitting second to the left of M. S the cricketer is sitting exactly between T and P. The accountant is sitting second to the right of the cricketer. N is sitting third to the left of T. S, R, N, L, M, T, O O M, O M M R, P R P, M T M S, T P N, T (i) Who among the following is a supervisor? (a) S (b) N (c) L (d) M (ii) Who among the following is a reporter? (a) S (b) O (c) L (d) N (iii) Who is sitting on the immediate left of the shop- keeper? (a) L (b) P (c) N (d) S (iv) How many people sit between teacher and supervisor? (a) Only 1 (b) Only 2 (c) Only 3 (d) Only 4 (v) Who are immediate neighbour of accountant? (a) N & S (b) M & P (c) S & P (d) N & M

Eight friends - P, Q, R, S, T, V, W and Y are sitting around a square table in such a way that four of them sit at four corners of the square while four sit in the middle of each of the four sides. The ones who sit at the four corners face the centre while those who sit in the middle of the sides face out side. P, who faces the centre sits third to the right of V. T who faces the centre, is not an immediate neighbour of V. Only one person sits between V and W. S sits second to right of Q. Q faces the centre. R is not an immediate neighbour of P. P, Q, R, S, T, V, W Y P V T V V W S, Q Q R, P (i) Who sits third to the right of Y? Y (a) S (b) Q (c) R (d) W (ii) Who sits between S and Q? S Q (a) T (b) R (c) W (d) V (iii) Which of the following pairs represents the persons sitting opposite to each other? (a) RQ (b) YS (c) PS (d) WT (iv) If each person interchanges his position with the person seated opposite, who will be on the immediate right of Q? Q (a) R (b) V (c) W (d) Y (v) Who among the following is facing opposite to the centre? (a) P (b) R (c) S (d) T

Ten persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I and J are sitting in two rows with five persons in each row in such a way that one person in the first row sits exactly oppo- site and facing a person in the second row. Members of the first row are facing North. B Sits in the first row to the immediate right of H who sits exactly opposite of D. C is at the extreme end of second row and is second to the left of D. A is to the immediate right of D and exactly opposite to F. G sits exactly opposite to E who is at one of the ends of the second row. J does not sit at the end. A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I J B, H D C D A, D F G, E J (i) Which direction is J facing? J (a) North (b) South (c) East (d) None of these (ii) Who is sitting opposite to B? B (a) C (b) D (c) J (d) I (iii) Which direction is I facing? I (a) North (b) South (c) East (d) None of these (iv) How many people sit between G & B? G B (a) 1 (b) 2 (c) 3 (d) None of these (v) Who sits second to the left of A? A (a) J (b) B (c) C (d) D

Ten persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I and J are split into two teams X and Y of 5 members each. Members in the two teams are made to sit in two rows facing each other in such a way that one member of team X is sitting exactly opposite of a member in team Y. Members of team X are facing North. D is third to the right of A and sits exactly opposite of G. B sits to the immediate right of G and is facing south. H is third to the right of B and is exactly opposite of F. C sits between A & B and is opposite of I. A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I J X Y X D, A G B, G H, B F C, A E I (i) How many people sit between I and G? I G (a) 1 (b) 2 (c) 3 (d) None of these (ii) Which of the following pairs represents the members of team X who are sitting at both the ends? X (a) AE (b) FA (c) FD (d) AC (iii) Which of the following pairs represents the members of team Y who are sitting at both the ends? Y (a) GH (b) HI (c) JB (d) JG (iv) Who is sitting opposite to E? E (a) J (b) I (c) B (d) G (v) Who is sitting in the middle of the team X? X (a) A (b) C (c) E (d) F

Twelve people are sitting in two parallel rows contai- ning six people each, in such a way that there is an equal distance between adjacent persons. In row- 1: P, Q, R, S, T and V are seated and all of them are facing South. In row-2: A, B, C, D, E and F are seated and all of them are facing North. Therefore, in the given seating arrangement each memebr seated in a row faces another member of the other row. P, Q, R, S, T V A, B, C, D, E F A sits third to right of D. Neither A nor D sits at extreme ends. T faces D. V does not face A and V does not sit at any of the extreme ends. V is not an immediate neighbour of T. B sits at one of the extreme ends. Only two people sit between B and E. E does not face V. Two persons sit between R and Q. R is not an immediate neighbour of T. C does not face V. P is not an immediate neighbour of R. A, D A D T D V A V V, T B B E E, V R Q R, T C, V P, R (i) Who is sitting between T and V? T V (a) P (b) Q (c) S (d) R (ii) How many people sit between B and C? B C (a) 1 (b) 2 (c) 3 (d) 4 (iii) Who is sitting opposite to A? A (a) R (b) S (c) T (d) P (iv) Who sits third to the left of Q? Q (a) T (b) V (c) R (d) S (v) Who are sitting at both the ends in row-1? (a) T, Q (b) T, S (c) P, Q (d) V, S

Twelve people are sitting in two parallel rows contai- ning six people each, in such a way that there is an equal distance between adjacent person. In row- 1: A, B, C, D, E and F are seated and all of them are facing South. In row-2: P, Q, R, S, T and V are seated and all of them are facing North. Therefore, in the given seating arrangement each member seated in a row faces another member of the other row. V sits third to right of S. S faces F and F does not sit at any of the extreme ends of the line. D sits third to right of C. R faces C. The one facing E sits third to right of P, B and P do not sit at the extreme ends of the line. T is not an immediate neighbour of V and A is not an immediate neighbour of C. A, B, C, D, E F P, Q, R, S, T V V, S S F F D, C R C E P B P T, V A, C (i) Who are sitting at both the ends in row-1 ? (a) A, D (b) B, E (c) D, E (d) A, F (ii) Who are immediate neighbours of R? R (a) P, Q (b) S, Q (c) S, V (d) P, V (iii) Who is sitting on the immediate left of B? B (a) F (b) D (c) C (d) E (iv) Who is sitting opposite to A? A (a) Q (b) R (c) S (d) V (v) Who is opposite to the person who is sitting second to the left of R? R (a) D (b) F (c) B (d) A

Twelve people are sitting in two parallel rows contai- ning six people each, in such a way that there is an equal distance between adjacent person. In row- 1: P, Q, R, S, T and V are seated and all of them are facing South. In row-2; A, B, C, D, E and F are seated and all of them are facing North. Therefore, in the given seating arrangement each membr seated in a row faces another member of the other row. P sits third to the left of T. Neither P nor T sits at an extreme end of the line. A sits second to the right of E. Neither A nor E faces T or P. A does not sit at an extreme end. R does not face A and R does not sit at an extreme end of the line. Only one person sits between F and C. Neither F nor C faces T. C does not sit at the extreme end. Only one person sits between V and Q. F is not an immediate neighbour of B and A does not face V. P, Q, R, S, T V A, B, C, D, E F P, T P, T A, E A E, T P R R, A R F C F, C, T C V Q F, B A, V (i) How many people sit between E & D? E D (a) 1 (b) 2 (c) 3 (d) 4 (ii) In which of the following pairs is the first person sitting in between the second and the third person. (a) VTQ (b) QRP (c) ABC (d) CDE (iii) Who sits third to the right of S? S (a) Q (b) P (c) R (d) T (iv) In which of the following pairs is the first person sitting to the immediate right of the second person? (a) RP (b) VQ (c) BC (d) DF (v) What is the position of A with respect to D? D A (a) Second to the left/ (b) Third to the left/ (c) Second to the right/ (d) Third to the right/

Seven players- Amanat, Bushra, Tamanna, Aaliya, Salma, Fatima and Damini are standing in a line. Salma and Bushra have two players between them. Aaliya and Fatima have two players between them. Damini is to the immediate right of Aaliya and to the immediate left of Bushra. Amanat is to the imme- diate right of Tamanna. Amanat and Aaliya have one player between them. (i) How many players are standing between Amanat and Fatima? (a) 2 (b) 3 (c) 4 (d) 5 (ii) Who is second to the right of Damini? (a) Aaliya (b) Fatima (c) Tamanna (d) Salma (iii) What is the position of Bushra with respect to Aaliya? (a) Second to the left/ (b) Third to the left/ (c) Second to the right/ (d) Third to the right/ (iv) Which of the following pairs represents the players sitting at both the ends of the row? (a) Tamanna-Damini (b) Salma-Fatima (c) Tamanna-Fatima (d) Amanat-Bushra (v) Who are immediate neighbour of Salma? (a) Tamanna & Aaliya (b) Fatima & Bushra (c) Amanat & Tamanna (d) Amanat & Aaliya

Eight players L, M, N, O, B, C, A & D are sitting around a circle. There of them are facing the centre and five of them are facing opposite to the centre. Two persons are sitting between D & A and two per- sons are sitting between B & A. N is sitting second to the left of C, who is facing centre. m is facing centre. M is sitting third to the right of B. O is not an immediate neighbour of D. N is sitting third to the left of O, who is second to the right of L, who is facing opposite to centre. L, M, N, O, B, C, A D D A B A N, C M M, B O, D N, O L O, B N B (i) Who are immediate neighbours of O? O (a) M & N (b) C & D (c) A & C (d) C & B (ii) Who is on the immediate right of M? M (a) N (b) D (c) C (d) O (iii) Who is sitting opposite to B? B (a) L (b) M (c) D (d) O (iv) Who is facing the centre? (a) A (b) B (c) D (d) O (v) What is the position of O with respect to D? D O (a) Second to the left/ (b) Third to the left/ (c) Fourth to the left/ (d) Third to the right/

Eight friends- A, B, C, D, L, M, N and O are seated in a straight line, but not necessarily in the same order. Same of them are facing North while some are facing South. Only three persons sit to the left of N. B sits second to the right of N. C sits third to the left of O. O is not an immediate neighbour of B. O does not sit at any of the extreme ends of the line. C and O face same direction (i.e. if C faces north then O also faces north and vice-versa). Both the immediate neighbours of D face North. D does not sit at any of the extreme ends of the line. persons sitting at extreme ends face opposite directions (i.e. if one person faces north then the other faces south and vice-versa) Both the immediate neighbours of N face same direction (i.e. if one neighbour faces North then the other also faces North and vice-versa) A sits second to the left of L. D faces a direction opposite to L. (i.e. if L faces north then D faces south and vice- versa) A, B, C, D, L, M, N O N B, N C, O O, B O C O D D N A, L D L (i) Which of the following faces north? (a) C (b) D (c) A (d) L (ii) Which of the following faces south? (a) N (b) B (c) O (d) M (iii) Which of the following pairs represents the persons sitting at both the ends of the row? (a) OD (b) AM (c) LM (d) OB (iv) What is the position of D with respect to C? C D (a) Second to the left/ (b) Third to the left/ (c) Second to the right/ (d) Third to the right/ (v) How many people sit between O & M? O M (a) 3 (b) 4 (c) 5 (d) 6

Eleven persons Z, B, X, W, V, U, G, H, I, J and P are sitting in a row facing North. Only four of the given eleven persons are carying money with them in the form of one rupee coins. But not more than two of such persons (carrying money) can sit together. Z, B, X, W, V, U, G, H, I, J P One of the immediate neighbours of Z is coring some money and he has one coin less then the number of person sitting to the left of him. J is an immediate neighbour of Z and B. The amount of money W has is the same as the sum of the number of coins of all the persons sitting to the left of him. H is to the imme- diate left of W and third to the right of I. Immediate neighbour of U has one coin less than him. Z J, Z B W H, W I U One of the immediate neighbours of X is carring coins. W, who is to the immediate left of U, is second to the right of X. J sits third to the left of G. Z is second to the right of V, who is at one of the ends. U has same number of coins as the number of persons sitting between him and the person who has two coins. X W, U X J, G Z, V U U (i) Which of the following has money? (a) P (b) B (c) G (d) H (ii) Who is on the immediate left of J? J (a) B (b) Z (c) P (d) I (iii) How many coins does W have? W (a) 2 (b) 3 (c) 4 (d) 5 (iv) How many coins does U have? U (a) 3 (b) 4 (c) 5 (d) 6 (v) Which of the following pairs represents the persons sitting at both the ends in the row? (a) XW (b) JI (c) VU (d) GH

Eight friends- A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a straight line facing North. Each of them will celebrate their birthday in different months viz. January, February, March, April, May, June, July and August but not necessarily in the same order. A sits third to the right of D. Only one person sits between A and the one whose birthday is in month which has 30 days. H sits third to the left of one whose birthday is in April month. B sits third to left of one whose birthday is in June month More than two persons sit between D & G. G sits left of D. H and B are not immediate neighbours of D. F's birthday is in month which has less than 30 days. F is not in immediate neighbour of D. The one whose birthday is in January sits third to left of one whose birthday is in April. The one whose birthday is in March sits second to right of one whose birthday is in Jaunary. The one whose birthday is in July sits second to the right of C. Immediate neighbour of E does not born in the month of August. A, B, C, D, E, F, G H A, D A H, B, D G G, D H B, D F F, D C E (i) In which month is D's birthday? D (a) May (b) March (c) January (d) April (ii) In which month is H's birthday? H (a) May (b) March (c) January (d) April (iii) Who sits third to the right of E? E (a) C (b) F (c) A (d) D (iv) Who are immediate neighbours of B? B (a) H & E (b) G & H (c) A & C (d) C & D (v) In which of the following is the first person sitting in between the second and the third person? (a) G B E (b) H B E (c) C D F (d) C F A

D, E, F, G, H, P, Q and R are seated in a straight line but not necessarily in the same order. Some of them are facing South while some are facing North. G faces South direction. D sits fourth to the left of P. P sits at one of the extreme ends of the line. Both the imme- diate neighbours of D face North. E sits second to left of R. R is not an immediate neighbour of D. Neither R nor F sits at the extreme end of the line. F faces opposite direction to G. Both the immediate neighbours of F face North. H sits to the imme- diate left of Q. Immediate neighbour of G face oppo- site directions (i.e. if one neighbour of G faces North then the other faces South and viceversa). Immediate neighbour of E face opposite direction (i.e., if one neighbour of E faces North then the other faces South and vice-versa). People sitting at the extreme ends face the opposite directions. D, E, F, G, H, P, Q R G D, P P D E, R R, D R, F F G F H, Q G E (i) In which direction is E facing? E (a) South (b) North (c) West (d) None of these (ii) How many people sit between G & Q? G Q (a) 2 (b) 3 (c) 4 (d) 5 (iii) What is the position of F with respect to R? R F (a) Third to the left/ (b) Fourth to the left/ (c) Third to the right/ (d) Fourth to the right/ (iv) Which of the following pairs represents the persons sitting at both the ends in the row? (a) EF (b) PQ (c) GH (d) GQ (v) Who are immediate neighbours of H? H (a) F & H (b) G & H (c) P & R (d) F & Q

P, Q, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing away from the centre. They have different number. of grapes with them. P sits second to the right of one who has highest number of grapes. T has more grapes than Q and S, but not the highest. The one who has the lest number of grapes sits on immediate right of P, who is not next to Q. The one who has the second least sits second to the left of the one who has second highest number of grapes. Q does not have the least number of grapes. P, Q, R, S T P T Q S P Q Q (i) Which of the following pairs represents the persons who have the highest and the least number of grapes? (a) PS (b) RQ (c) TS (d) RS (ii) Who has the second highest number of grapes? (a) T (b) R (c) P (d) Q (iii) Who are immediate neighbours of Q? Q (a) S & P (b) S & R (c) R & T (d) P & R (iv) Who sits second to the right of S? S (a) Q (b) P (c) R (d) T (v) Who has the second least number of grapes? (a) S (b) P (c) R (d) Q

A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around the two circular tables in two different rooms of the same house. In one room four persons are sitting towards the centre while in other room four people are facing away from each other. Both the tables are kept along the wall joining the two rooms, the table around which four people are facing towards the centre is placed to the left of the wall joining the two rooms.
